requirement: The system shall allow a user to register with name, email and password when self-registration is enabled.
The system shall allow a user to authenticate, refresh a session and log out.
The system shall provide a single-use, expiring password-reset flow.
The user shall be able to view and update permitted profile and notification settings.
The user shall be able to request deletion or deactivation according to the configured retention policy.
Passwords shall be stored only as adaptive password hashes.
Protected API routes shall validate an unexpired access credential.
Server-side role policies shall distinguish USER, ADMIN and INVESTIGATOR permissions.
Server-side object ownership shall prevent users from reading or modifying another user's transactions, images, reports or notifications.
Authentication and password-reset endpoints shall be rate limited and shall not permit account enumeration.
Only an authorised administrator shall assign or revoke roles.
The mobile application shall allow a user to capture a receipt with the camera or choose an image from the gallery.
The API shall accept only configured JPEG, PNG and WEBP receipt images within configured byte and dimension limits.
The server shall assign generated object keys and store original receipt images privately.
The system shall calculate and persist a SHA-256 hash for each original receipt.
The system shall calculate a perceptual hash and identify exact or near-duplicate candidates without exposing other users' data.
Receipt storage and database creation shall fail consistently without leaving uncontrolled orphan records or objects.
The system shall calculate basic image-quality warnings before OCR.
The system shall create versioned derived preprocessing variants without modifying the original image.
The system shall retain raw OCR text, token bounding boxes and confidence values.
The system shall extract transaction reference, amount/currency, relevant names/phones, date/time, provider where detectable and status text where present.
The system shall normalise Ghanaian phone formats, currency amounts, dates/times and transaction references consistently.
The mobile application shall mark low-confidence or invalid fields for user review.
User corrections shall preserve the original OCR value and create an audit trail.
Unknown receipt layouts shall use a generic parser and return explicit limitations rather than fail silently.
The system shall prevent final analysis until required OCR review/state conditions are met.
The system shall record metadata/format evidence without treating missing metadata alone as fraud.
The system shall calculate versioned recompression/error-level summary features on derived images.
The system shall calculate noise/residual consistency features when image quality permits.
The system shall calculate layout, crop/completeness and OCR text-alignment evidence.
Each image-evidence signal shall store value, version, threshold/rule, severity and reason code.
No single weak heuristic shall alone force a fraudulent classification unless configured as a documented critical rule.
Private diagnostic derivatives may be generated for authorised review.
Every ML model shall be registered with type, version, artifact hash, feature/preprocessing schema, training commit and status.
The structured classifier shall output class probabilities and a predicted risk class using a versioned feature pipeline.
The image classifier shall output a tampering probability or an explicit unavailable/error state.
Only an authorised administrator shall activate or roll back a model version after readiness checks.
The system documentation shall report actual held-out metrics and label synthetic-only evaluations.
Training runs shall record dataset/split hashes, seed, dependencies and code commit.
Dataset source groups shall be split before augmentation or preprocessing fit.
An administrator shall be able to upload a reference-transaction CSV for preview and validation.
Committed imports shall record source label, file hash, uploader, row counts and import status.
The system shall locate a candidate reference record using canonical provider/reference fields when available.
The system shall compare amount, currency, relevant phone/name values and timestamp within versioned tolerances.
The system shall return VERIFIED, UNVERIFIED or MISMATCH and persist the evidence.
The user interface shall state that prototype verification is based on stored/imported records.
Fraud risk and verification status shall remain separate in storage, API and UI.
The system shall flag repeated reference or receipt reuse according to versioned rules.
The system shall persist raw image, structured-model and rule components used in risk aggregation.
The initial risk function shall be configurable and default to 40% image, 40% structured ML and 20% rules until calibrated.
Risk thresholds shall be versioned and selected from validation evidence.
Every result shall provide a small ordered list of plain-language reason codes grounded in evidence.
A failed/unavailable subsystem shall produce a PARTIAL state and disclose missing evidence.
Repeated analysis requests with the same idempotency key and unchanged input shall not create uncontrolled duplicate analyses.
Completed results shall not be silently recomputed when models, rules or thresholds change.
Users shall see only their own paginated transaction history.
History shall support date, risk, verification, provider and processing-status filters.
A user shall be able to download an authorised analysis summary with masked sensitive values and disclaimers.
The system shall create in-app notifications for analysis completion, configured high-risk outcomes and case-status changes.
Users shall be able to view unread counts and mark their own notifications read.
Historical reports shall retain the result/model/rule versions used at the time.
A user shall be able to report one of their analysed transactions as suspicious with a category and description.
Configured high-risk results may create or queue a case without duplicating an existing open case.
An investigator shall be able to inspect all authorised evidence and timeline information.
Confirm, dismiss and escalate actions shall require an investigator reason and valid state transition.
Human review shall not overwrite the original automated risk or verification result.
An investigator shall be able to generate an authorised case report.
Administrators shall manage users, account status and authorised roles.
Administrators shall manage versioned receipt templates and parsers' configuration metadata.
Administrators shall manage versioned fraud rules and thresholds.
Administrators shall view registered model versions and readiness/activation status.
The portal shall display risk, verification, case and processing aggregates for an authorised date range.
Administrators shall search audit events by actor, action, target, date and request ID.
Administrators shall see readiness of database, storage, Tesseract, active models and optional notification adapters.
Security-sensitive, evidential and privileged actions shall create append-only audit events.
Audit records shall include actor, action, target, timestamp, request ID and safe metadata.
All API errors shall use a consistent envelope with code, message, request ID and field details when safe.

The API shall expose liveness, readiness and version endpoints.

requirement: Login and normal history requests should complete within 2 seconds under defined prototype load.
A normal receipt analysis should complete within about 10 seconds under defined prototype conditions.
The prototype logical design shall support 25 concurrent analyses and 100,000 stored analysis records without schema redesign.
All non-local traffic shall use HTTPS and secure session/cookie settings.
Secrets shall be provided through environment/secret management and excluded from client bundles and Git.
Receipt files shall be treated as hostile and stored privately.
The system shall minimise, mask and restrict receipt-derived personal data according to role and purpose.
The deployed prototype shall target 99% availability during agreed operating hours.
Database writes that form one domain action shall be transactional where required.
The OCR pipeline shall target at least 90% required-field accuracy on the declared evaluation set.
The fraud classifier shall target macro F1 of at least 0.85 on a leakage-controlled held-out test set.
A signed-in user shall begin receipt analysis in no more than three principal actions.
Status shall not be communicated by colour alone and critical interfaces shall support accessible labels and keyboard/focus behaviour.
Routes, services, repositories, persistence, storage and ML components shall be modular and independently testable.

requirement: Every automated result shall retain enough evidence, versions and timestamps to be reconstructed.
Database and private storage backup/restore procedures shall be documented and tested on staging/local data.
The mobile app shall support the agreed current Android test range and the admin portal current major evergreen browsers.
Private real receipt data shall not be committed to Git and shall have documented consent/licence and retention status.
